hypothesis: Answer normalization and relative quotas can discard between-answer count evidence; this is not assumed to be the only limitation.
folds: FOLDS_V2.json prmbench.outer; entire canonical source groups
training_population: all training answers, without consulting classifications or labels
ranking: one canonical donor IU-PCR fit per bank/fold; LSML secondary; immutable stable descending ranks

A.r: pooled within-answer population SD on active observations
A.weights: unchanged canonical LSML within-group coefficients on bridge coordinates
A.group_scaling: absolute donor mean/SD; local canonical answer-z

B.eligibility: full fit strict probability interior, >=180 valid bootstrap fits, every pair covariance .025 quantile > 0
B.selection: min IQR(prevalence)/sqrt(pi*(1-pi)); exact ties by sorted feature member indices
B.orientation: all three positively covarying voters better than chance; not independence proof

C.median: smallest k with exact PB CDF >= .5
C.PB_assumption: conditional independent step labels and fixed parameters; mean sum needs no step independence

D.boundary_diagnostic: rho=0, refit theta; no new candidate
D.activation: preregistered because frozen incumbent already fails k=0

control_training: all fitted stats, DS survivor selection, thresholds and entropy cutoff training-only; historical transductive replay separate

success.MAE: upper one-sided paired difference <0 vs Q80 and LEGACY_MOM
success.PRMScore: lower one-sided paired difference >0 vs Q80
success.recall: lower one-sided paired difference >-.01 vs Q80

metrics.partial_Spearman: residual average-tie ranks on intercept and rank(n_steps)
metrics.true_count: sum valid-step annotation membership; no out-of-range repairs
metrics.interval_limit: conditional on saved OOF fits, not whole-learning-procedure uncertainty

retrospective_context: family motivated by already inspected development evidence; new protocol is prospective only for these new runs
